children: Oil rises in early trade amid renewed fighting in the Middle East that could lead to supply disruptions. U.S. forces attacked two Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, the U.S. Central Command said. Central Command said the Iranian launchers, which were deployed on Larak Island, were preparing to fire rockets filled with sea mines into the strait when they were struck. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical waterway through which one-fifth of the world's oil is transported. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 1.7% higher at $84.84 per barrel; front-month Brent crude oil futures are 1.8% higher at $88.70 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
